name: steproute
description: Logs a steproute routing decision and its outcome for every subagent spawn; in route mode applies the recommended model at the spawn. Shadow mode (log only) by default.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: log decisions and outcomes, change nothing. route: also apply the recommended model and effort when a subagent starts. off: do nothing. The STEPROUTE_MODE environment variable overrides this.

service_url.title: Service address
service_url.description: Base URL of the local steproute serve process. The STEPROUTE_URL environment variable overrides this.

decide_timeout_ms.title: Decision timeout (ms)
decide_timeout_ms.description: How long a subagent spawn waits for a decision before going ahead with Claude Code's own choice.

report_timeout_ms.title: Outcome report timeout (ms)
report_timeout_ms.description: How long the end of a subagent run waits for the outcome to be stored before going on; a report that fails is kept and resent later.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: subscription: outcomes record cost_usd = 0 (no per-request charge). api: cost_usd is left for the service to price at catalog rates.

route_agent_types.title: Agent types route mode may change
route_agent_types.description: Comma-separated subagent types whose model route mode may set. Types not listed are logged but keep their own model. Use * for every type.
